RealTimeDataFetcher.docstring:
Class for fetching real-time data from Alpha Vantage and Polygon APIs.

Attributes:
    ALPHA_BASE_URL (str): Base URL for Alpha Vantage API.
    POLYGON_BASE_URL (str): Base URL for Polygon API.

PolygonDataFetcher.docstring:
Class for fetching historical and real-time data from the Polygon API.

Attributes:
    data_lake_handler (Optional[DataLakeHandler]): Handler for storing data in a data lake.

DataFetcher.docstring:
Base class for fetching financial data from APIs.

Attributes:
    api_key (str): The API key for authentication.
    base_url (str): The base URL for the API.
    raw_csv_dir (str): Directory to store raw CSV files.
    processed_csv_dir (str): Directory to store processed CSV files.
    db_path (str): Path to the SQLite database.
    log_file (str): Path to the log file.
    source (str): The source of the data (e.g., AlphaVantage).
    data_lake_handler (Optional[object]): Handler for storing data in a data lake.

BaseAPI.docstring:
A base class for interacting with APIs.

Attributes:
    base_url (str): The base URL of the API.
    api_key (str): The API key for authentication.
    logger (logging.Logger): Logger for logging messages.

AlphaVantageAPI.docstring:
A class for interacting with the Alpha Vantage API.

Inherits from BaseAPI.

CustomIndicators.docstring:
A class providing custom technical indicators with caching support.
This class supports both memory and file-based caching strategies.
